title: outbound-url.v1 — the outbound URL rule's case table
description: Whether a server may fetch a URL somebody else supplied, written as cases. Every implementation of the rule (the Python ssrf.py vendored into each image that fetches such a URL, and the bot's TypeScript url-guard.ts) is held to this table by its own test suite, reading a byte-identical copy of the golden (scripts/parity.json, fact outbound-url-vectors).

what.description: Prose: what the table is and how each section is read.

addresses.description: is_blocked_ip: an IP address, in any notation the rule reads, and whether a connection to it is refused.

addr.description: May be empty: an empty address is a case too.

hostnames.description: is_blocked_hostname: a host name refused before any lookup because it can only name this deployment.

host.description: May be empty: an empty host is a case too.

urls.description: validate_url: a URL, the resolver's answer for its host (null for a literal address, where no lookup happens), and whether the URL is refused.
